name: STT Jaipur 1
developer: ST Telemedia Global Data Centres India
notes: Official STT GDC launch says STT Jaipur 1 is a high-performance/enterprise-grade data centre in Jaipur with 6 MW IT design capacity and 10 MVA total power load; ET data-centre press corroborates 6 MW and RIICO Industrial Area/Tonk Road details.

name: Rajasthan State Data Centre Jaipur estate (RSDC P1/P3/P4 including Bhamashah State Data Centre)
developer: Department of Information Technology & Communication, Government of Rajasthan / RISL
notes: Rajasthan investment portal states the state data centre has 800 racks across Jaipur plus 1 Jodhpur DR site; APMG certification lists RSDC-P1, P3 and P4 locations in Jaipur. Sterling & Wilson project page identifies Bhamashah State Data Center in Jaipur as a 600-rack, Tier IV-certified greenfield project completed in 2019.

name: MNIT Jaipur AI Data Centre
notes: DD India reports Union Minister Ashwini Vaishnaw outlined plans for an AI data centre and expanded academic/research facilities at MNIT Jaipur; capacity and implementation schedule were not disclosed.

name: R3esolution Infotech Pvt LTD
notes: DataCenterMap lists R3esolution Infotech Pvt LTD as headquartered in Jhunjhunu and operating as a colocation/cloud/network provider, but the listed data center location appears to be Mumbai and no credible public source found a distinct Jhunjhunu facility; retained as weak datacenter activity rather than a confirmed local build.

name: Rajasthan State Data Centre Disaster Recovery Site, Jodhpur
developer: Department of Information Technology & Communication, Government of Rajasthan / RISL
notes: APMG certification lists RSDC-DR in Jodhpur as part of Rajasthan State Data Centre service scope; DoIT&C 2026 FMS tender covers RSDC Phase I-IV at Jaipur and Disaster Recovery Site at Jodhpur.

name: Disaster Data Recovery Center Cum AI Compute, Jodhpur
developer: Department of Information Technology & Communication, Government of Rajasthan
notes: DoIT&C tender page shows an EOI for selecting an agency for establishment and maintenance of a Disaster Data Recovery Center Cum AI Compute in Jodhpur, with EOI uploaded 2026-07-28 and submission due 2026-09-07; third-party tender aggregator reports value around Rs 300 crore.

name: IIT Jodhpur campus data center
notes: IIT Jodhpur describes a modern campus computer-centre data center with more than forty 42U racks, precision cooling and redundant power backups; included as institutional data center capacity rather than commercial colocation.
